heading: Today
text: Patches of morning fog giving way to sun, mixing with clouds.  An isolated afternoon shower or thunderstorm.  Continued very warm and humid.  Highs in the 80s to near 90.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Tonight
text: Periods of clouds, with scattered showers or thunderstorms, mostly near or after midnight.  A few patches of fog.  Mild and muggy.  Lows in the 60s to near 70.  Winds light and variable.

heading: Saturday
text: Morning clouds, a few localized showers or a thunderstorm, then breaks of sun, with additional scattered afternoon showers and storms.  Warm and humid.  Highs in the low to mid 80s.  Winds light, becoming south near 10 mph from the Green Mountains west.
